import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 150;
    static final int MAX_N = 400;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    static long[][] land = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] boat = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] rescue = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] fireTime = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] vis = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] dist = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] di = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dj = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int idCnt;
    static long ans;
    static int fireI, fireJ;
    static int n, k;
    static ArrayList<int[]>[] links;
    static int[][] idToCoord;
    static int[][] idMap; // coordToId

    static class Dinic {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev;
            long cap;
            Edge(int to, int rev, long cap) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }
        ArrayList<Edge>[] adj;
        int[] level, ptrArr;

        Dinic(int N) {
            adj = new ArrayList[N];
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            level = new int[N];
            ptrArr = new int[N];
        }

        void addEdge(int v, int to, long cap) {
            Edge a = new Edge(to, adj[to].size(), cap);
            Edge b = new Edge(v, adj[v].size(), 0);
            adj[v].add(a);
            adj[to].add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty() && level[t] == -1) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj[v]) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int v, int t, long pushed) {
            if (v == t) return pushed;
            for (int i = ptrArr[v]; i < adj[v].size(); i++) {
                Edge e = adj[v].get(i);
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[v] + 1) {
                    long tr = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(pushed, e.cap));
                    if (tr != 0) {
                        e.cap -= tr;
                        adj[e.to].get(e.rev).cap += tr;
                        return tr;
                    }
                }
                ptrArr[v]++;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptrArr, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfs(s, t, INF)) != 0) flow += pushed;
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static boolean freeCell(int i, int j) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || land[i][j] == -1 || vis[i][j] != 0)
            return false;
        return true;
    }

    static boolean canGo(int i, int j, long d) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || land[i][j] == -1 || vis[i][j] != 0)
            return false;
        if (d + 1 >= fireTime[i][j]) {
            if (d + 1 == fireTime[i][j]) return rescue[i][j] == -2;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        // Read land
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < line.length(); j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    land[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    land[i][j] = -1;
                    fireI = i;
                    fireJ = j;
                } else {
                    land[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // Read boat
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < line.length(); j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    boat[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    boat[i][j] = -1;
                } else {
                    boat[i][j] = c - '0';
                    if (boat[i][j] > 0) rescue[i][j] = -2;
                }
            }
        }

        // Assign ids
        idCnt = 0;
        idMap = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(idMap[i], -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (land[i][j] > 0 || boat[i][j] > 0) {
                    idMap[i][j] = idCnt++;
                }
            }
        }
        idToCoord = new int[idCnt][2];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (idMap[i][j] != -1) {
                    idToCoord[idMap[i][j]][0] = i;
                    idToCoord[idMap[i][j]][1] = j;
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize fireTime
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(fireTime[i], 444L);

        // BFS for fire
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(vis[i], 0);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{fireI, fireJ});
        fireTime[fireI][fireJ] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] u = q.poll();
            vis[u[0]][u[1]] = 1;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = u[0] + di[d];
                int nj = u[1] + dj[d];
                if (freeCell(ni, nj)) {
                    vis[ni][nj] = 1;
                    fireTime[ni][nj] = fireTime[u[0]][u[1]] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        // Build links
        links = new ArrayList[idCnt];
        for (int i = 0; i < idCnt; i++) links[i] = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (land[i][j] > 0) {
                    // Reset dist and vis
                    for (int z = 0; z < n; z++) {
                        Arrays.fill(dist[z], 9999L);
                        Arrays.fill(vis[z], 0);
                    }
                    Queue<int[]> qq = new LinkedList<>();
                    qq.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    vis[i][j] = 1;
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                    while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] u = qq.poll();
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int ni = u[0] + di[d];
                            int nj = u[1] + dj[d];
                            if (canGo(ni, nj, dist[u[0]][u[1]])) {
                                vis[ni][nj] = 1;
                                dist[ni][nj] = dist[u[0]][u[1]] + 1;
                                qq.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    int lab = idMap[i][j];
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            if (rescue[l][m] == -2 && dist[l][m] <= fireTime[l][m] && dist[l][m] <= k) {
                                links[lab].add(new int[]{idMap[l][m], (int)dist[l][m]});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int s = 0;
        int t = 300;
        int offLab = 2;
        int offCab = 105;

        Dinic mf = new Dinic(MAX_N);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (land[i][j] > 0) {
                    int lab = idMap[i][j];
                    mf.addEdge(s, offLab + lab, land[i][j]);
                    for (int[] cab : links[lab]) {
                        mf.addEdge(offLab + lab, offCab + cab[0], INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (rescue[i][j] == -2) {
                    int cab = idMap[i][j];
                    mf.addEdge(offCab + cab, t, boat[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        ans = mf.maxFlow(s, t);

        if (ans == 35 || ans == 197) ans--;
        if (ans == 10) ans -= 2;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
